text: After this you can compare energy performance after allowing for changes in operating drivers.

Use a baseline to represent expected consumption under specified conditions. Weather, production, and occupancy may help explain differences in energy use. Regression models relationships between these drivers and measured consumption; CUSUM accumulates deviations from an expected pattern. An energy performance indicator (EnPI) links performance to a relevant basis. Check missing readings, altered operations, and data quality before drawing conclusions.
